laws: Computer-science depth is an overlay, never a hidden expansion of VOL-000..420.
Every layer has an implementation contract, acceptance proof, owners, dependency identity, maturity and evidence state.
Implementation and independent verification signatures are distinct.
A complete layer requires current exact-head evidence plus both signatures.
Security, privacy, authority, tenant isolation, state integrity, rollback, human control and reproducibility are non-compensable where applicable.
Research-only layers cannot imply production capability without promotion evidence.
Cross-layer optimizers may tune bounded parameters but cannot grant authority or weaken hard gates.
Stale prerequisite evidence revokes downstream qualification.
CS300-300 is the only finality layer and cannot self-attest.
